# Background photos

These three backgrounds are **AI-generated**. They were made with ForgeGUI image generation
("thumbnail" type, 1376 x 768) on 2026-10-27, then re-encoded as JPEG to strip metadata.
`scripts/generate_labels.py` composites the drawn test labels onto them, so the photo
fixtures look realistic while their ground truth stays exact. The backgrounds were asked to
contain no text. The bar shelves still show blurred bottle labels, which is realistic noise
for the readers.

| File | Prompt |
|---|---|
| `bar-counter.jpg` | Photorealistic photograph, not illustration: a dark walnut wooden bar counter seen from a slightly elevated angle, warm amber pendant lights, softly blurred bar shelves in the background. The center foreground of the counter is completely empty and evenly lit, a flat clear area where a paper card could lie. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, labels or signage anywhere in the image. Natural camera photo, realistic lighting, shallow depth of field. |
| `blank-bottle.jpg` | Photorealistic product photograph, not illustration: one plain amber glass whiskey bottle standing upright, front view, centered, on a neutral light grey seamless studio background. The bottle has one large blank rectangular cream-colored paper label on its front with absolutely nothing printed on it: no text, no letters, no logo, no pattern. The label is flat-on to the camera and occupies the middle third of the bottle height. Soft studio lighting, realistic glass reflections. No text anywhere in the image. |
| `kitchen-counter.jpg` | Photorealistic smartphone photo, not illustration: a speckled grey granite kitchen countertop under cool, slightly dim overhead fluorescent light, photographed from above at a gentle angle. The middle of the countertop is an empty, flat, uncluttered area where a sheet of paper could lie. A blurred coffee mug at the far edge. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or labels anywhere in the image. Realistic, slightly underexposed, mild shadows. |
